[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Well then. There's only one place he'd go.[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]That's it! As I fought Black Face,[XENO:n ]

Prison Island?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]I've never been.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But I've heard of a black tower[XENO:n ]

They say it was built by the ancient High Entia race.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

I thought they were a myth![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]I wouldn't blame you, son.[XENO:n ]
An ancient race living at the top of the Giant God?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It does sound crazy. But Giant God is home to all kinds of[XENO:n ]
different people, not just us. That includes the High Entia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The High Entia? I'd dismissed them as folklore as well.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Never assume anything.[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Have you ever met one?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Well, yeah.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Wow! Dickson, man, you're just full of surprises![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
What can I say? I'm well travelled.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

And it's all for your future. Day and night[XENO:n ]

and gained knowledge for our people.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Stop your whining.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Who asked you, Dunban?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]We'll head there.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

the colonies, find a place the Mechon will not[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I see. Then I am obliged to join you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I've recovered a great deal since we last met.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]I might not be in peak condition, but I'm useful.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

So you keep saying...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
